<thoughtml>
  <title>Bridge Open/Close Decision</title>

  <observations>
    <observation>Surface cracking has increased since last year's inspection.</observation>
    <observation>Measured loads remain within the published load limit.</observation>
    <observation>An engineer has confirmed that temporary monitoring is feasible.</observation>
  </observations>

  <decision_question>
    May the bridge remain open while temporary monitoring is implemented?
  </decision_question>

  <reasons_for_remaining_open>
    <reason>Current load measurements are within the published limit.</reason>
    <reason>Temporary monitoring could provide ongoing evidence of bridge behavior.</reason>
    <reason>Immediate closure may be unnecessary if risk controls are effective.</reason>
  </reasons_for_remaining_open>

  <reasons_for_closure>
    <reason>Cracking has progressed since the previous inspection.</reason>
    <reason>Surface deterioration may indicate an underlying structural problem not captured by current load measurements.</reason>
    <reason>Continued public use could increase consequences if deterioration accelerates.</reason>
  </reasons_for_closure>

  <current_position>
    The team provisionally supports keeping the bridge open only under temporary engineered monitoring, with appropriate load controls and frequent inspections. The decision should be revisited immediately if cracking worsens, monitoring identifies unsafe behavior, or loads exceed the published limit.
  </current_position>
</thoughtml>
